highlights: Windows media play, pause, next, previous, and stop keys now use Electron's valid native accelerator names.
Closing or restarting Ignifire no longer shows a JavaScript error from media-key cleanup.
Only successfully registered media shortcuts are removed during shutdown.
Native shortcut cleanup can no longer interrupt an update restart or normal exit.
notes: Fixes the Windows main-process error caused by invalid media-key accelerator names and makes native shortcut cleanup safe during shutdown.
